title: Comply with long service leave requirements
summary: This page provides information about complying with long service leave requirements for both workers and employers.
what_you_need: For workers, information is available through NSW Industrial online information.
For employers, you can use the online long service leave calculator.
Employers can download the NSW Industrial Relations Long Service Leave Guide.
contact: If you need help understanding how long leave service may apply to you or your business contact NSW Industrial Relations.

external_links.text: Go to NSW Industrial Relations FAQs on long service leave

faqs.q: Where can I find common questions about taking and getting paid for long service leave?
faqs.a: You can find common questions about taking leave and getting paid through the NSW Industrial Relations FAQs on long service leave.

faqs.q: How can I check my employee's long service leave entitlements?
faqs.a: Use the online long service leave calculator to check your employees' entitlements.

faqs.q: Who should I contact if I need help understanding long leave service?
faqs.a: Contact NSW Industrial Relations if you need help understanding how long leave service may apply to you or your business.
